summary: Verified all three bug fixes for the pump.fun/RH micro-stake bot. (1) BACKEND: PUT /api/bot/config with body {enabled:false, rh_feed_enabled:true} while bot running — response.enabled stayed true, GET /api/bot/status.enabled stayed true, rh_feed_enabled applied. Restore + hard stop worked. (2) FRONTEND: rh-feed-toggle, helius-tracker-toggle, rh-paper-toggle all flip visually on click, persist after 2.5s, and restore correctly. STOPPED stays STOPPED after feed toggle; RUNNING stays RUNNING after feed toggle (no start/stop side effects). (3) FRONTEND: minimize-all yields uniform full-width strips — measured all 8 min-strips + 3 collapsible sections at 1550px vs section-bot-control reference 1552px (Δ=2px). expand-all restores wrap. Single-card minimize (min-btn-wallet) also produces full-width strip (1550px). Bot left in original PAPER/STOPPED state, all toggles restored to original values.

issues: Pre-existing React warning in console: 'Encountered two children with the same key, `null`' — appears multiple times during wallet minimize/expand and initial render. Likely from a list rendering with a null key (candidates: trade history, launch feed, or wallet holdings). Not caused by current fixes but worth flagging.

action_items: Investigate React duplicate key warning (key=null) triggered during dashboard re-renders — inspect .map() calls in TradeHistoryCard / LaunchFeed / WalletCard / RhWalletCard for items with null id.
